votes.motion: Approve variance for septic system offset at 1491 Mass Avenue, reducing requirements from 100 feet to 90 feet for primary system and 100 feet to 60 feet for reserve area
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by rudd and second by jewell, a roll call vote was called as follows: rudd - yes pirro - yes jewell - yes proctor - recuse variance was approved.

votes.motion: Designate the apartment at 3 Chase Road as a studio apartment
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by pirro and second by jewell, t he board voted to make this apartment as studio apartment. all in favor

votes.motion: Grant an extension until May 18, 2026 at 4:30 pm for resolution of water seepage issue at 41 New West Townsend Road
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by rudd, the board granted an extension until may 18th at 4:30 pm at which time a solution must be provided. all in favor.

votes.motion: Reclaim the use of the Septic Repair Fund from Parks Commission for use by the Board of Health
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by rudd and second by pirro, the board voted to take back the use of the septic repair fund for use by the board of health. all in favor.
having no further business and on motion by rudd and second by proctor the meeting was adjourned at 5:30 pm. all in favor.
